newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon economic activity rises in July-cen bank.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon economic activity rises in July-cen bank.

text.p: Lebanon's economic activity rose in July to its highest level in over three and a half years, the Bank of Lebanon said in its monthly bulletin on Wednesday.

The central bank said its coincident indicator of economic activity rose to 179.8, its highest level since it was created in January 1993. It stood at 168.8 in June and reached a previous high of 168.9 last October.
"The rise is mainly due to a pick-up in construction," the Bank said.
The indicator, which takes January 1993 as 100, combines 12 economic series including imports, exports, electricity output and airport and port activity.
The Bank created the indicator because of a lack of reliable data in Lebanon since the 1975-90 war, which prevents precise calculation of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) and other growth data.
